mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand growth, which increases corporate revenue visibility and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 109.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side capacity utilization, which may signal an impending economic slowdown and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% combined with a CPI reading above 250.0 signals a tightening monetary policy stance in response to persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars combined with a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which pressures corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 109.5 over three consecutive months indicates a structural supply-side slowdown, reducing output and increasing input costs, which pressures profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 109.5 in t-1mo and t-2mo and t-3mo
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
